source_review.notes: Checked all ten final NASA and FAA references on 2026-08-31; every URL returned HTTP 200. Reviewed NASA's interface requirements outline, integration planning, interface and requirements management, product integration and verification, technical requirements definition, NPR 7123.1B, the NASA Systems Engineering Handbook, and the FAA Test and Evaluation Handbook. Claims about interface definition, horizontal traceability, integration order, controlled change, and verification are kept within their source contexts.

evidence: Reviewed offered and required contract notation O_A, R_A, O_B, and R_B over declared interface domain D_i.
Reviewed bilateral compatibility conditions O_A models R_B and O_B models R_A.
Reviewed composed-system notation A parallel B against interface requirements I_i.
Confirmed the text distinguishes static attributes from sequence, timing, shared-state, resource, security, environment, and recovery behavior.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Notation is defined locally and used as a conditional compatibility model, not as a universal calculus or formal proof of interoperability.

evidence: Executed interface-compatibility-fixture under python3 with exact output in artifacts/snippets/SYSENG-076/report.json.
Confirmed all eight declared static attributes initially match and the status is compatible_for_declared_static_rules.
Confirmed changing engineering_units alone produces after_unit_change_mismatches=engineering_units and incompatible status.
Recomputed Exercise 2 burst backlog as (2000-1000)*30=30000 messages, exceeding the 20000-message buffer.
Recomputed overflow time as 20000/(2000-1000)=20 seconds and post-burst drain time as 20000/(1200-800)=50 seconds.
numerical_recomputation.notes: The arithmetic is correct under explicitly simplified constant-rate assumptions; batching, variable service, retries, bytes, shared load, and backpressure could change a real result.

evidence: Confirmed one-sided provider conformance does not entail bilateral compatibility because the reverse required/offered relation is independent.
Confirmed two static conformance relations do not entail composed behavioral conformance for time, state, shared resources, faults, or recovery.
Confirmed syntactic schema compatibility does not entail unit, coordinate, temporal, identity, or domain-semantic compatibility.
Confirmed pairwise compatibility does not entail multi-party compatibility when shared identity, network, quota, power, or control resources couple parties.
Confirmed backward compatibility is conditioned on a concrete provider-consumer version and feature pair rather than a version label alone.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: The chapter uses implication limits and counterexamples, not an unsupported claim that its compact notation decides all interface properties.

evidence: Challenged geometry, accumulated tolerances, loads, environment, grounding, leakage, startup transients, and physical access.
Challenged units, coordinate frames, timestamp bases, precision, optional/default/null fields, enums, payload limits, and semantic drift.
Challenged initialization, deadlock, cancellation, duplicate, reorder, loss, late acknowledgment, timeout, retry amplification, restart, and ambiguous effect.
Challenged burst overload, buffer exhaustion, slow consumers, shared-resource bottlenecks, priority inversion, and recovery ramp.
Challenged perfect mocks, capture-plane ambiguity, clock skew, missing telemetry, privacy constraints, and symptom-location bias.
Challenged mixed-version rollout, rollback, stored/replayed messages, supplier firmware changes, security downgrade/replay, and organizational handoffs.
Reviewed all ten worked examples and five complete answers for assumptions, intermediate reasoning, evidence limits, and bounded conclusions.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: A credible real review requires relevant mechanical, electrical, fluid, software/data, network, security, safety, human-factors, supplier, operations, configuration, and interface-owner expertise as applicable.

evidence: Confirmed every interface retains identified parties, planes, responsibilities, baseline, precedence, owner, and change authority.
Confirmed assumptions and guarantees remain horizontally traceable across provider, consumer, and shared obligations.
Confirmed units, frames, signs, time, tolerances, encodings, identity, and version semantics are explicit verification surfaces.
Confirmed side conformance precedes but never substitutes for evidence from actual peer composition.
Confirmed evidence is bound to both party versions plus infrastructure, configuration, data, environment, tools, and procedures.
Confirmed anomalies remain jointly governed and multi-party interface change requires impact analysis and selective reverification.
invariant_checking.notes: Connector fit, parse success, local unit tests, emulator success, HTTP success, electrical continuity, or pairwise nominal pass is never treated as sufficient alone.

proof_review.notes: The chapter contains no formal proof or theorem whose correctness requires a proof review; it presents contract relations, bounded arithmetic, and counterexamples.

proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No passage is labeled or presented as a proof sketch.

evidence: Executable output is labeled synthetic_static_contract_attributes_only.
Fixture discussion explicitly excludes semantics, sequences, real timing, conversion accuracy, faults, security, and integrated implementations.
Worked examples are analytical teaching cases and do not claim field test, operational acceptance, compliance, certification, or production interoperability.
Official sources are attributed without claiming external endorsement or local system approval.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Synthetic contract checking, source-backed guidance, internal review, actual-peer verification, validation, and acceptance remain distinct evidence categories.

conceptual_review.notes: Internal conceptual review checked interface planes, assumptions/guarantees, bilateral and multi-party contracts, horizontal traceability, static and behavioral compatibility, real composition, versioning, anomaly ownership, verification versus validation, and evidence limits.

practitioner_review.notes: Internal practitioner-oriented review checked interface inventory and authority, IRD/ICD controls, physical/electrical/data/state/timing/capacity/security/human dimensions, side and pairwise testing, mock fidelity, observability, rollout/rollback, joint diagnosis, supplier change, and reverification triggers.

pedagogical_review.notes: Internal pedagogical review confirmed progression from the bilateral compatibility model through static, dynamic, physical, organizational, lifecycle, and integrated evidence. Ten distinct examples and five complete solutions cover tolerances, units, timing, transients, state machines, mocks, versions, handoffs, shared resources, and supplier change.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external NASA/FAA expert, interface control working group, domain engineer, software/data/network owner, security/safety reviewer, human-factors specialist, supplier, operator, configuration authority, independent V&V organization, acceptance authority, certification body, or other external academic or practitioner review is claimed.
